desc: 白底整箱加单瓶双主图，运动补水场景与空白参数信息图，突出清爽冷感
name: 运动后清爽补水电解质风味水款

shots.intent: 搜索列表第一眼：整箱与单瓶同框，一眼看清买到的形态
主图一秒法则：色块底上单瓶侧影加空白件数徽标，一秒读懂买整箱
shots.textZone: right 40% green field, blank rounded badge and slim strip carrying only 「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 放大高强度训练后口干乏力、急需补水的痛点
让买家代入训练后大口补水的即时解渴瞬间
用图标加空参数行的结构承接卖点说明，数值一律留白待填
以冰冷水珠与封口细节证明新鲜冷链质感
俯看整箱装载与提瓶动作预期，消除到货破损疑虑
收口促成整箱下单，用空白按钮位承接行动召唤
shots.textZone: lower right blank rounded button carrying only 「{callout_2}」

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white studio stage #FFFFFF for packshots, alternating with flat fruit-green fields #4CA30C, open sky #2E6FB8, raw concrete #B9B4AD and pale condensation grounds #F1F3F2
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line glyphs in fruit-green #4CA30C, outline only, no letters, no digits, no medical or certification symbols
style.lightingSystem: cool neutral high-key studio light, large front-left softbox key with a fill card, thin sweeping rim on bottle caps, soft contact shadows, never harsh or dramatic
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean cold sports-hydration beverage visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white stage #FFFFFF, fresh fruit-green accent #4CA30C, cool condensation grey-blue #DCE5E9 and charcoal text #33383D; cool neutral high-key studio lighting with a large front-left softbox key, fill card, thin sweeping rim and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif in one family; thin single-weight line icons only in the accent colour; bottled beverage always crisp, chilled and beaded with condensation, held at a stable slight 3/4 or straight-on hero angle with constant scale; every carton panel, badge, table cell and seal stays blank and unprinted; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no printed numbers, units or nutrition values anywhere
style.presentationRules: bottle kept upright, cold and condensation-beaded with a stable slight 3/4 or straight-on hero angle and constant scale across the set; every printed panel, badge and table stays blank
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless cyclorama and light stone ledges #E7E9E6, always cold and lightly beaded with condensation
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one family only, headline plus two short labels maximum, all wording carried by placeholders
